git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Overhaul: fix 22 audited bugs, integrate features, zero-warning builds, bilingual READMEs

Bug fixes (audited by a 58-agent workflow, adversarially verified):
- Workbook grading: empty results now throw a clear localized error
  instead of silently reporting 0/0; error strings localized; model
  suggestions corrected (qwen-vl-plus typo)
- AI photo cleanup: callers can now tell cleanup ran vs. skipped/failed;
  PhotoTranslateView shows a notice banner and an "AI cleaned" badge
  with one-tap revert to the original OCR text
- Speech recognition: mic tap/engine/audio session torn down on error
  paths (idempotent stopRecording, no didFinish after didFail)
- Photo OCR honors an explicit scan-language choice instead of always
  re-detecting; in-flight OCR tasks cancel cleanly when superseded
- Data safety: all four UserDefaults stores load via a shared helper
  with last-known-good backups and os.log on decode failures; activity
  date keys pinned to POSIX/Gregorian; vocabulary dedup/removal
  normalize invisible Unicode; SavedTermsStore.update reports failure
- PinyinConverter no longer echoes non-CJK input as fake pinyin
- Live speech "Use Translation" fills in both transcript and result
- Daily review counter rolls over past midnight

Integration & features:
- Photo and speech translations now write Translation History and Stats
- History tab: direction filter, no-matches state, clear-all confirmation
- AI settings: per-provider Test Connection plus Vision/JSON capability badges
- Pinyin position setting now works (above/below/inline) and is on iOS too
- TranslateView AI progress shows the actual provider; a11y labels added
- Anthropic default models reordered newest-first

Project & build hygiene:
- pbxproj: removed 149 duplicate Sources entries and 43 legacy refs,
  stopped bundling handoff.md, excluded logs/MandarinKit.md via a
  synchronized-group exception set (67KB -> 19KB)

  via duplicate CpResource outputs); gitignored

- Fixed every compiler warning (deprecated API, spurious try/await,
  unused values, never-executed branch, Sendable capture)
- Deleted dead code (Item.swift, AppTab.title)

Localization & docs:
- +47 catalog keys with reviewed zh-Hans translations (608 keys,
  verified: no existing entries altered, placeholders intact)
- Grammar-point and direction-name strings localized
- README updated and full Simplified Chinese README added (cross-linked)

Both platforms build clean: zero errors, zero warnings.
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1
